<thought>After validation, the original merging created unintended parallel paths because node N1 was shared between subnet 1 and subnet 3. The measurements indicate the network is a simple series chain, giving a total A‑B resistance of about 41.364 Ω, which matches the sum of all eight resistor values. Therefore, I rename the N1 node in subnet 3 to a distinct identifier (e.g., N1_3) so that the three subnetworks connect only at the intended shared nodes (A, X1, X2, B). This yields a linear topology that satisfies all measurements.</thought>
